newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Clinton nuke seen down 4-5 days.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Clinton nuke seen down 4-5 days.

text.p: Illinois Power Co's 930 megawatt Clinton nuclear power plant in Clinton, Ill. is expected to be shut for four-to-five days for repairs to a recirculation pump seal, a company spokesman said.
"We estimate it will be four to five days before we bring (Clinton) back on line," spokesman John Dewey said Friday.
Illinois Power began reducing electricity output at the plant early Friday morning after a leak was discovered in a recirculation pump seal, Dewey said.
The plant is expected to be fully shut at about 1000 CDT/1100 EDT on Friday, the spokesman said.
Illinois Power is a unit of Illinova Corp.
